title: Two Routes to Interoceptive Prioritisation: Dissociating Likelihood Precision and Preference Reweighting in Active Inference
abstract: arXiv:2610.18617v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: An embodied agent must prioritise among competing bodily needs. In active inference, it can respond to an urgent need by increasing the precision of information about that need or by increasing its preference for outcomes that relieve it. We compare these two interventions, separately and together, in a foraging gridworld with three lethal needs, and ask how each changes survival, perception and the body model the agent learns. Precision sharpens interoceptive posteriors and improves survival. Preference reweighting keeps bodily states further from their lethal boundaries and changes the states from which the agent learns, so its learned model covers fewer need levels, with lower quality across all levels but slightly higher quality on the levels it visits. translated_title: 内感受优先化的两条路径：在主动推断中分离似然精度与偏好重加权
translated_abstract: 具身智能体必须在相互竞争的身体需求之间进行优先级排序。在主动推断框架中，智能体可以通过提高与该需求相关信息的精度，或通过增加对能缓解该需求的结果的偏好，来应对紧急需求。我们在一个包含三种致命需求的觅食网格世界中，分别以及联合比较这两种干预措施，并探究每一种干预如何改变生存表现、感知以及智能体学习到的身体模型。精度干预使内感受后验更加锐化并提高生存率。偏好重加权使身体状态更远离致命边界，并改变了智能体从中学习的状态，因此其学习到的模型覆盖的需求水平更少，在所有水平上质量较低，但在其访问过的水平上质量略高。在72个额外布局上的实验未能证实预期的偏好干预在困难布局上的收益，但两种干预均能提高该场景下的平均生存率，且两者的交互作用……
tldr: 该研究在主动推断框架下通过觅食网格世界实验分离比较了应对身体需求的两种干预——提高内感受信息的似然精度与偏好重加权，发现精度能锐化内感受后验并提高生存率，而偏好重加权使身体状态远离致命边界，但会改变学习到的身体模型的覆盖范围与质量。
en_tdlr: This study dissociates two active inference interventions for prioritising bodily needs—interoceptive likelihood precision and preference reweighting—in a foraging gridworld, showing that precision sharpens interoceptive posteriors and improves survival, while preference reweighting keeps bodily states further from lethal boundaries but reshapes the coverage and quality of the learned body model.
